name: Cash runway
description: Cash and cash equivalents at the period end divided by the average monthly net decrease in cash over the trailing three calendar months.

decrease.label: Net decrease in cash over 3 months

unavailableWhen.reason: cash did not decrease over the trailing 3 months: there is no burn, so runway is not defined
no cash at the period end

sign: Months; higher = longer before cash runs out at the recent burn rate.

period.semantics: cash at the period end; burn over the 3 calendar months ending on the period end

freshness.note: computed only from a projection that has caught up with the ledger
